decisions.rationale: Methodology 9.461 deliberately withholds physical GOLD/SILVER delivery from the fiat valuation path. The asset peg reference can price token-denominated metal, but using it for the delivered bar would be a scoring-policy ruling about bar identity, unit conversion, delivery charges, and same-notional retention—not a missing repository price mapping. Safety Score methodology owner approval is required; no scoring change was made.
decisions.nextReviewTrigger: Safety Score methodology owner approves a versioned physical-delivery valuation contract that binds bar identity/quantity, commodity reference, fees, and observation time; then follow ADR-3.

decisions.rationale: Plasma carries 10.3692% of captured supply and was the sole uncovered material deployment. Reviewed 2026-09-21 at Plasma block 33042050 (09:24:03 UTC; hash 0x51f33ca98394e28f65d931b794ddb669fe114953a792d6888590a015429d3f13). PlasmaScan and Routescan exact-match verify the direct, non-proxy USDeOFT deployment. USDeOFT inherits the ordinary OFT/OpenZeppelin ERC-20 transfer and transferFrom paths; its _debit override applies rate limiting only to cross-chain send, not local holder transfers, and the verified source has no local pause, blacklist, allowlist, seizure or upgrade path. Official Plasma RPC reads pinned to this block returned owner() = 0x2c57434603f21f580c91a3bdc0cc5f3f20278632, a zero EIP-1967 implementation slot, and reverted paused() and isBlacklisted(address) probes. Source review, rather than those absent-selector probes alone, establishes unrestricted local transfers; owner rate-limit and LayerZero configuration authority concerns bridge access instead. The asset-level reviewedAt remains the older existing review date and does not refresh Ethereum or Solana evidence. Actual scoped compiler changed bounded-unknown/null to known/permissionless. factsClosed is one expected closure, not production publication confirmation; fresh replay remains required.

decisions.rationale: Sei carries 16.7376% of captured chain supply, above the 10% material threshold, and was the sole uncovered material deployment. Reviewed 2026-09-21 at Sei block 233262650 (09:21:59 UTC). SeiScan exact-match verifies the OptimizedTransparentUpgradeableProxy and BridgeableTokenUpgradeable implementation 0x78b57cc8dacd63c16290f136c60b403163b8d89e. Block-pinned implementation()/admin() calls and EIP-1967 slots agree on that implementation and effective immutable ProxyAdmin 0xd25d45c640e25f90d3ab70f69856f5494e9415cd. The verified implementation exposes ordinary ERC-20 transfers, role-gated mint and holder-self burn; paused() and isBlacklisted(address) probes revert. ProxyAdmin owner() is verified TimelockController 0xd08472b9b2e6c3633d9872863e3fde0daad1ef13; getMinDelay() is 43200 seconds, proposer 0x4ea00dc0c2b3933b9b41c6cc372832fe844a89ae has PROPOSER_ROLE, and EXECUTOR_ROLE is open after the delay. The live timelock can replace transfer logic through the only-owner upgrade path, so this deployment is restrictable even though current transfers are open. The asset-level reviewedAt remains the older existing review date; this new deployment observation does not refresh the other deployments. Actual scoped compiler smoke on the fixed capture changed transfer from bounded-unknown/null to known/restrictable. factsClosed records the one expected transfer-sentinel closure, not a claim of production publication; fresh production replay remains required. Freeze tasks are independently owned.

decisions.rationale: PAXG is one fine troy ounce per token and has a 430 PAXG minimum per London Good Delivery bar. Paxos defers the numeric redemption fee to a non-public User Guide or customer Pricing Supplement, and makes the customer responsible for delivery without publishing a charge ceiling. Its USD streaming-quote alternative likewise has no public numeric commission or minimum and is not the physical-delivery output.
decisions.nextReviewTrigger: Paxos publishes the numeric redemption fee and a bounded all-in physical delivery charge.

decisions.rationale: KAU represents one gram of gold and has a 100 KAU minimum plus 0.45% and $100 charges, but Kinesis adds a delivery fee that varies by country and provides only a location-dependent quote, with no numeric upper bound.
decisions.nextReviewTrigger: Kinesis publishes a bounded delivery charge or numeric delivery-fee ceiling for KAU physical redemption.

decisions.rationale: KAG represents one troy ounce of silver and has a 200 KAG minimum plus 0.45% and $100 charges, but Kinesis adds a delivery fee that varies by country and provides only a location-dependent quote, with no numeric upper bound.
decisions.nextReviewTrigger: Kinesis publishes a bounded delivery charge or numeric delivery-fee ceiling for KAG physical redemption.

decisions.rationale: PGOLD represents one troy ounce and has a 32.15 PGOLD minimum plus a published 0.5% redemption fee. Pleasing's legal terms additionally impose handling, insurance and delivery fees under an unpublished Fee Schedule, with no public numeric amount or ceiling; those charges cannot be treated as zero.
decisions.nextReviewTrigger: Pleasing publishes the numeric Fee Schedule or a bounded ceiling for handling, insurance and delivery charges.

decisions.rationale: GLDY represents one fine troy ounce, but Streamex's current public primary pages publish neither a physical minimum nor a numeric physical-redemption, fabrication, shipping or custody schedule. RWA.xyz is secondary and internally inconsistent: it displays 2%, describes 4% for physical fabrication/shipping/handling/administration, and separately lists the greater of $500 or 5% (1% introductory). No current primary all-in schedule can be encoded safely.
decisions.nextReviewTrigger: Streamex publishes a current primary physical minimum and bounded all-in schedule covering redemption, fabrication, shipping, handling and custody.

decisions.rationale: XAGm has a 2,100-token minimum, a 0.50% redemption fee and a live 0.998463014 ozPerToken when reviewed. Physical redemption is by pickup or secured delivery, but Matrixdock publishes no numeric secured-delivery price or ceiling; the ozPerToken custody deduction can also change under the terms.
decisions.nextReviewTrigger: Matrixdock publishes a bounded secured-delivery charge or numeric ceiling and stable fee treatment compatible with the live ozPerToken value.

decisions.rationale: CGO represents one gram of gold. The current FAQ says 10 CGO minimum while the contractual 2022 Terms say 1,000 CGO; making and delivery are charged without numeric bounds, post-24-month storage is described only as nominal, and the linked fee-structure page publishes no readable numeric schedule.
decisions.nextReviewTrigger: ComTech reconciles the physical minimum and publishes bounded making, delivery and applicable storage charges.

decisions.rationale: Each GLDT represents 0.01 gram and the advertised physical minimum is 100 GLDT / 1 gram through a reverse swap into a GLD NFT. Gold DAO's current redemption instructions do not publish the reverse-swap fee. Bity separately charges CHF 300 per vault pickup regardless of size or quantity, permits pickup only in Zurich, and publishes no USD-denominated flat bound or delivery service/charge. The end-to-end terms therefore do not fit the required bounded USD fee model.
decisions.nextReviewTrigger: Gold DAO publishes the complete reverse-swap fee and Bity publishes a bounded USD-denominated physical redemption/delivery schedule.
